where: crates/blaze-scope/src/cells/switch.rs solve_and_write: the scopes loop's `Unwritten::Unknown` came before the `member_refusal` check
what: a one-group solve whose member reads a module with no record decides that module's cells `Outside`, so the member's import is unknown; the solve then refused `Unknown { module: member }` and never reported the cause it had recorded (`MemberRefusal::NoRecord { module }`), which is the one refusal an on-demand driver (cells/lazy.rs) can answer
cost: found by reading before the first run; would have been a confusing failure
cause: two refusals of one cause, checked in the order the code was written rather than cause first
class: a symptom refusal reported before the refusal of its cause
prevention: done: the member refusal is checked before the scopes are written
annoyance: the queue's 30-line cap per test cuts a two-table measurement: split it into one test per table
workaround: one #[test] per table; each test also writes its lines to a temp file
